name: Actual Harvest Projection
script:
# --- Get parameters from the API call (sent by frappe.call on the client) ---
greenhouse   = frappe.form_dict.greenhouse
crop_variety = frappe.form_dict.crop_variety
iso_year     = frappe.form_dict.year
week_no      = frappe.form_dict.week_no

# If year or week were not provided, default to "last week"
if not iso_year or not week_no:
    today = frappe.utils.now_datetime().date()
    iso   = today.isocalendar()       # (year, week, weekday)
    iso_year = iso[0] if not iso_year else iso_year
    week_no  = iso[1] - 1 if not week_no else week_no

# ---- Run the query for the specified greenhouse/variety/year/week ----
qty = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT IFNULL(SUM(sed.qty), 0)
    FROM `tabStock Entry` se
    JOIN `tabStock Entry Detail` sed ON sed.parent = se.name
    WHERE se.stock_entry_type = 'Harvesting'
      AND se.docstatus = 1
      AND se.custom_greenhouse = %s
      AND sed.item_name       = %s
      AND WEEK(se.posting_date, 1) = %s
      AND YEAR(se.posting_date)    = %s
""", (greenhouse, crop_variety, week_no, iso_year))[0][0]

# Return the result to the caller
frappe.response["message"] = qty

script:
created = [] updated = [] for row in (doc.bed_numbers or []): exists = frappe.db.exists({ "doctype": "Bed", "greenhouse": doc.greenhouse, "bed": row.bed_no }) if exists: bed = frappe.get_doc("Bed", { "greenhouse": doc.greenhouse, "bed": row.bed_no }) bed.farm = row.farm or doc.farm bed.variety = row.variety_grown or doc.variety bed.bed_length = row.bed_length bed.bed_width = row.bed_width bed.bed_area = row.bed_area bed.total_variety_area = doc.total_beds_area bed.save(ignore_permissions=True) updated.append( f"Bed No {row.bed_no} updated " f"(Variety: {row.variety_grown or doc.variety}, " f"Area: {row.bed_area} m²)" ) else: bed = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "Bed", "greenhouse": doc.greenhouse, "farm": row.farm or doc.farm, "variety": row.variety_grown or doc.variety, "bed_length": row.bed_length, "bed_width": row.bed_width, "bed_area": row.bed_area, "bed": row.bed_no, "total_variety_area": doc.total_beds_area }) bed.insert(ignore_permissions=True) created.append( f"Bed No {row.bed_no} created " f"(Variety: {row.variety_grown or doc.variety}, " f"Area: {row.bed_area} m²)" ) if created: frappe.msgprint("
".join(created), title="New Bed(s) Created", indicator="green") if updated: frappe.msgprint("
".join(updated), title="Existing Bed(s) Updated", indicator="blue") if not created and not updated: frappe.msgprint("No Beds were created or updated.", indicator="orange")

name: Bed Sampling Expected Harvest Calculator
script:
total_sampled_area = frappe.utils.flt(doc.get("total_sampled_area") or 0) area_covered_by_variety = frappe.utils.flt(doc.get("area_covered_by_variety") or 0) current_week = frappe.utils.cint(doc.get("week_no") or 0) # --- Totals by stage --- rice_total = 0.0 ball_total = 0.0 colour_break_total = 0.0 full_colour_break_total = 0.0 for row in (doc.get("growth_stages") or []): rice_total = rice_total + frappe.utils.flt(row.get("rice_stage") or 0) ball_total = ball_total + frappe.utils.flt(row.get("ball_stage") or 0) colour_break_total = colour_break_total + frappe.utils.flt(row.get("colour_break_stage") or 0) full_colour_break_total = full_colour_break_total + frappe.utils.flt(row.get("full_colour_break_stage") or 0) total_stems = rice_total + ball_total + colour_break_total + full_colour_break_total # --- Yield forecasts (per stage) --- if total_sampled_area and area_covered_by_variety: this_week_yield = (full_colour_break_total * area_covered_by_variety) / total_sampled_area next_week_from_colour_break = (colour_break_total * area_covered_by_variety) / total_sampled_area next_week_from_ball = (ball_total * area_covered_by_variety) / total_sampled_area next_week_from_rice = (rice_total * area_covered_by_variety) / total_sampled_area else: this_week_yield = 0 next_week_from_colour_break = 0 next_week_from_ball = 0 next_week_from_rice = 0 # --- Store this week's yield --- doc.db_set("forecast_yield", this_week_yield) # --- Get actual growth stage timing from Variety Growth Stages --- def get_growth_stage_weeks(variety_name): """Get the actual week offsets for each growth stage from the variety configuration""" try: if not variety_name: return {"colour_break": 1, "ball": 7, "rice": 9} # Get the variety's growth stage group item = frappe.get_doc("Item", variety_name) growth_stage_group = item.get("custom_growth_stages_group") if not growth_stage_group: frappe.msgprint(f"Warning: No growth stage group found for {variety_name}, using defaults", indicator="orange") return {"colour_break": 1, "ball": 7, "rice": 9} # Get the growth stage configuration vgs = frappe.get_doc("Variety Growth Stages", growth_stage_group) week_offsets = {} for stage in vgs.get("growth_stage_configuration", []): days = frappe.utils.flt(stage.get("days_to_harvest") or 0) # Convert days to weeks (7 days per week, round up) weeks = int((days + 6) / 7) # Round up to nearest week stage_name = stage.get("growth_stage", "").lower() if "colour break" in stage_name and "full" not in stage_name: week_offsets["colour_break"] = weeks elif "full colour" in stage_name: week_offsets["full_colour"] = weeks elif "ball" in stage_name: week_offsets["ball"] = weeks elif "rice" in stage_name: week_offsets["rice"] = weeks # Fill any missing stages with defaults if "colour_break" not in week_offsets: week_offsets["colour_break"] = 1 if "ball" not in week_offsets: week_offsets["ball"] = 7 if "rice" not in week_offsets: week_offsets["rice"] = 9 return week_offsets except Exception as e: frappe.msgprint(f"Error getting growth stage timing: {str(e)}", indicator="red") frappe.log_error(f"Error getting growth stage weeks for {variety_name}: {str(e)}") return {"colour_break": 1, "ball": 7, "rice": 9} # --- Get the variety name correctly --- variety_name = doc.get("variety") # Main variety field if not variety_name and doc.get("growth_stages"): # Fallback to first growth stage row variety_name = doc.get("growth_stages")[0].get("variety") week_offsets = get_growth_stage_weeks(variety_name) # --- Target harvest week numbers --- week_colour_break = current_week + week_offsets["colour_break"] week_ball = current_week + week_offsets["ball"] week_rice = current_week + week_offsets["rice"] # --- DEBUG: Show what values will be set --- frappe.msgprint(f"DEBUG - Values to be set:
" f"colour_break_forecast: {next_week_from_colour_break:.0f}
" f"colour_break_harvest_week: {week_colour_break}
" f"ball_stage_forecast: {next_week_from_ball:.0f}
" f"ball_stage_harvest_week: {week_ball}
" f"rice_stage_forecast: {next_week_from_rice:.0f}
" f"rice_stage_harvest_week: {week_rice}", title="Debug - Forecast Values", indicator="blue") # --- STORE THE FORECAST DATA IN YOUR CUSTOM FIELDS --- doc.db_set("colour_break_forecast", next_week_from_colour_break) doc.db_set("colour_break_harvest_week", week_colour_break) doc.db_set("ball_stage_forecast", next_week_from_ball) doc.db_set("ball_stage_harvest_week", week_ball) doc.db_set("rice_stage_forecast", next_week_from_rice) doc.db_set("rice_stage_harvest_week", week_rice) # --- Build the message --- variety_info = f" for {variety_name}" if variety_name else "" message = ( f"Your expected harvest (Week {current_week}){variety_info}: {this_week_yield:.0f} stems

" f"Upcoming harvest forecast by stage
" f"• From Colour Break: {next_week_from_colour_break:.0f} stems " f"(expected harvest Week {week_colour_break})
" f"• From Ball Stage: {next_week_from_ball:.0f} stems " f"(expected harvest Week {week_ball})
" f"• From Rice Stage: {next_week_from_rice:.0f} stems " f"(expected harvest Week {week_rice})

" f"Total stems counted (by stage)
" f"• Rice stage: {rice_total:.0f} stems
" f"• Ball stage: {ball_total:.0f} stems
" f"• Colour Break stage: {colour_break_total:.0f} stems
" f"• Full Colour Break stage: {full_colour_break_total:.0f} stems

" f"Growth Stage Timing
" f"• Colour Break → {week_offsets['colour_break']} week(s)
" f"• Ball Stage → {week_offsets['ball']} week(s)
" f"• Rice Stage → {week_offsets['rice']} week(s)

" f"Summary
" f"• Total stems counted: {total_stems:.0f}
" f"• Total sampled area: {total_sampled_area}
" f"• Area covered by variety: {area_covered_by_variety}
" f"• Expected variety yield: {this_week_yield:.0f} stems" ) frappe.msgprint(message, title="Bed Sampling Forecast", indicator="green")
